questions.question: Which function is the entry point of a standard hosted C++ program?
questions.explanation: The main function is the entry point of a standard hosted C++ program. A common definition is int main() { ... }.

questions.question: Which statement prints Hello to standard output when <iostream> has been included?
questions.explanation: std::cout is the standard output stream. The << operator inserts the text into that stream.
